  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative (sentiment < 0) or shows recent negative momentum.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent high prices (last 5-7 days) when sentiment is positive (sentiment > 0), to avoid underestimating upward momentum.",
    "Apply a lag correction: if true outcome is significantly higher than forecast, reduce next forecast by 5-10% to avoid over-optimism.",
    "When model overestimates prices after a spike (e.g., >15% above true outcome), apply a downward bias correction to prevent overshoot.",
    "Use mean reversion heuristic: if forecast is consistently 5-10% above true outcome over 3 consecutive days, reduce forecast by 2-5% per day to align with historical mean.",
    "For sentiment = 0.5 or higher, increase forecast volatility by 10-15% to reflect bullish momentum, but cap at 20% above historical max.",
    "If sentiment is positive and price is trending downward, apply a 3-day smoothing filter to avoid premature reversal signals."
  ]
}
